content.title: How many Oscars did 'Sinners' win?
content.text: AdvertisementReturn to HomepageEntertainment: 'Survivor' surprise double-eliminationPlay Crushable by Candy CrushNew 'Harry Potter' series nameTaylor Frankie Paul backlashDuffer Brothers' new project'Sad Affleck' meme backstory'KPop Demon Hunters' happy meals'Harry Potter' series trailerMorgan Stewart on podcastingAndrew McCarthy's journeyBill for scrapped 'Bachelorette'Ryan Coogler's sensational film Sinners walked away as one of the big winners of this year's Academy Awards.How many Oscars did it win in total on Sunday night in Hollywood, you might ask?Four! Sinners won Best Actor for Michael B. Jordan, Best Original Screenplay for Coogler, Best Cinematography for Autumn Durald Arkapaw and Best Original Score for Ludwig Göransson.The film set a nominations record and walked away with the second-most Oscars awarded on the night. Not a bad night at all for one of 2025's most celebrated films.
